name: Schemathesis Open-Source API Testing
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed local CLI/Python tool for schema-based OpenAPI, GraphQL and gRPC API testing; no vendor-hosted testing quota or recurring credits included.
watch_out: Runs on your own workstation or CI runner; compute, network, target API usage and CI infrastructure may incur separate charges. Generated requests can modify data: use staging/test targets. Hosted services, if any, are not included.
